verdict.rationale: Meilisearch has a public pricing page offering a 14-day free trial (meilisearch-docs-56). A community comment cites a free tier followed by a $1200/month plan (meilisearch-comm-2), which suggests published tier prices but not per-unit rates. A user also reports that self-hosted RAM usage was unpredictable and expensive under heavy search traffic (meilisearch-comm-3), which works against cost predictability. Missing for 10: documented per-search, per-record or per-node rates; first-party plan price figures; any usage-based cost calculator or overage terms.
